officialApp.name: 3M Connected Equipment
officialApp.notes: 3M's connected-PPE app is used to set up and adjust the headset, including hygiene-kit replacement reminders. 3M does not document a battery percentage screen for this model.

battery.chargingIndicators: Low-battery warning only (audible/voice feedback). No percentage steps are published.
battery.notes: One combined headset battery: two AA alkaline cells, or optional NiMH rechargeables. Approximately 78 hours with Bluetooth streaming and level-dependent hearing protection running. No charging case. This is a passive hearing protector with level-dependent ambient sound, not an ANC headset.

anc.notes: No active noise cancellation. Protection is passive attenuation plus level-dependent ambient listening that compresses harmful noise; the level-dependent output is limited for hearing protection. Do not label this as ANC.

features.name: Certified passive hearing protection
features.notes: EN 352-1/EN 352-3 earmuff; exact SNR/NRR depends on cushion and mounting.

features.name: Level-dependent ambient listening
features.notes: Ambient microphones reproduce safe sounds and compress hazardous noise.

features.name: Push-to-Listen
features.notes: Instant ambient listening without removing the headset.

features.name: Bluetooth calls and streaming
features.notes: Bluetooth 4.2; HSP, HFP, A2DP and AVRCP. Connects to one external source; no multipoint.

features.name: Noise-cancelling boom microphone
features.notes: Electret boom microphone for hands-free calls in noise.

features.name: Four-hour auto power-off
features.notes: Turns off after four hours of non-use.

gestures.notes: Settings are adjusted through the app and confirmed by voice.

controls.physicalButtons: On/Off/Mode and +/− buttons on the cup; Push-to-Listen control.

audio.notes: 27 mm dynamic speakers, 100 Ω. Bluetooth 4.2 with A2DP. No multipoint (3M explicitly states one external source for the X).

featureDeltaFromPrevious: Bluetooth 4.2 streaming and hands-free calls with a noise-cancelling boom microphone.
